mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market weakening, which reduces risk premium pressures and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE increases below 4.5% in >60% of instances, or IC < 0.03 over 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate crossing above 4.5% triggers a risk premium adjustment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%, or threshold crossings occur <10% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month convergence of quarterly demand growth (GDPC1) rising and federal funds rates declining indicates economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: concurrent upward trend in GDPC1 and downward trend in FEDFUNDS over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in federal funds rates signals potential easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline during monetary tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS decline occurs during tightening, or IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects stronger production capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained INDPRO increases, or IC < 0.03 over 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly supply index (INDPRO) crossing above 101.96 (current level) signals improved production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses threshold, or threshold crossings occur <5% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month convergence of quarterly demand growth (GDPC1) rising and labor employment (PAYEMS) increasing indicates dual economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: concurrent upward trends in GDPC1 and PAYEMS over 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery regime, sustained increases in the supply index (INDPRO) signal improving production capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: any INDPRO increase during post-shock recovery
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO increases occur during recovery, or IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.
